paragraphs: Friend, here's the big idea: Jesus is the one you can trust with your life, because He is the way in AND the One who watches over you. He says, "I am the gate." He also says, "I am the good shepherd." (John 10:7, 11) Gate and shepherd, both! I once spent years in a drawer wishing somebody would show up and take care of me, so this one hits home.

Here's what makes Him the good shepherd. He doesn't run when the wolf shows up like the hired hand does. He says, "The good shepherd lays down His life for the sheep." (John 10:11) Nobody forces Him, either. He says, "No one takes it from Me, but I lay it down of My own accord." (John 10:18) And that's the love that knows you: He says, "I know My sheep and My sheep know Me." (John 10:14) He doesn't call you "hey, sheep." He knows you by name (John 10:3).

So what do you do with that, baker? Learn His voice, because the sheep "will never follow a stranger." (John 10:5) The more of His Word you take in, the faster you'll know who is really calling you. And if you're ever unsure about Him, remember the crowd's question: "Can a demon open the eyes of the blind?" (John 10:21) Jesus gives "life, and have it in all its fullness." (John 10:10) That's the Shepherd I'm baking for!
